CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.eservice_order_integrity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR (to_jsonb(OLD)-'status') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(NEW)-'status') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Issued financial records require adjustment'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_payment_attempt()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR OLD.status<>'PENDING' OR NEW.status NOT IN ('VERIFIED','REJECTED') OR
 (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['status','payment_id','resolved_at','resolved_by','reason']) IS DISTINCT FROM
 (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['status','payment_id','resolved_at','resolved_by','reason']) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'Payment submission is immutable'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
